title: The composition law for $Rf_!$
statement:
Use the finite-level coefficient datum of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]: $k$ is a field, $\ell$ is a prime invertible in $k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to S$ be separated finite-type morphisms between finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Let $Rf_!$ denote the compact-support direct image of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], restricted to the category $\mathcal D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(X,\Lambda)$ of pro-etale complexes with an etale-origin witness [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory]. These functors preserve the bounded-below etale-origin class. There is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$\alpha_{g,f}:Rg_!Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(g\circ f)_!$$
of functors $\mathcal D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(X,\Lambda)\to\mathcal D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(S,\Lambda)$, independent of all compactification choices under the comparisons of [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed]. Under the canonical identity and composition identifications it is the identity when $f$ or $g$ is an identity. For any third separated finite-type morphism $h:S\to T$ with $T$ a finite-type $k$-scheme, it is associative: the two composites $Rh_!Rg_!Rf_!\to R(hgf)_!$ agree after inserting the canonical associator.

proof.text: All schemes used below are Noetherian and qcqs. Indeed $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is Noetherian (a field has only the ideals $0$ and $k$), and [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] applies to each original finite-type $k$-scheme and then to each proper ambient scheme. Their quasi-separatedness follows from [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated]. Every open inclusion occurring here is quasi-compact: its source is quasi-compact and target quasi-separated, by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1). Thus the qcqs hypotheses of the geometric and site-comparison tools hold, including on all the open restrictions below.

source.place: Tags 0F7J and 0F7K: qcqs hypotheses; Noetherian finite-type specialization

proof.text:
Write $A_T=\nu_T^*$. For a candidate $F_c=Rp_*j_!$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], exactness [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact], [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact] allows the sheaf comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] to descend termwise through quasi-isomorphisms. Together with [prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image] for the proper qcqs map $p$, it gives
$$s_c:A_Y(Rp^{e}_*j^{e}_!L)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp^{p}_*j^{p}_!A_XL.$$
Hence the output of every candidate has the bounded-below etale-origin witness $(Rp^{e}_*j^{e}_!L,s_c)$; for a general witness $A_XL\xrightarrow{a}K$, compose $s_c$ with $F_c(a)$. All displayed comparisons are on $D^+$, and exact comparison pullback preserves this class. By full faithfulness [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison], any morphism $t:K\to K'$ between witnessed objects corresponds to a unique $t^e:L\to L'$ with $A_X(t^e)=a'^{-1}ta$. Consequently a transformation natural in $L$ gives, by this conjugation, a transformation natural for every morphism of [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory], independently of changing to an isomorphic witness.

Choose $d=(v:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y,q:\overline Y\to S)$ by [thm-nagata-compactification]. The compatible-triangle result [lem-weil-pbc-compatible-compactification-triangle] applied to $f,g,d$ supplies $e=(a:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,p:\overline X\to\overline Y)$ of $vf$, $V=\overline X\times_{\overline Y}Y$, $b:V\hookrightarrow\overline X$, $p_Y:V\to Y$, and $c:X\hookrightarrow V$ with $a=bc$ and $f=p_Yc$. In particular $(c,p_Y)$ compactifies $f$, $(a,qp)$ compactifies $gf$, and $pb=vp_Y$ is Cartesian. We use compactifications and refinements in precisely the category [def-weil-compactifications-refinements].

source.place: Tag 0F7J, lemma-shriek-composition, first diagram; blueprint Construction

proof.text:
For any two composable pro-etale open immersions $j_1,j_2$, the adjunction [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-adjunction] identifies
$$\operatorname{Hom}(j_{2!}j_{1!}M,N)=\operatorname{Hom}(M,j_1^*j_2^*N)=\operatorname{Hom}(M,(j_2j_1)^*N).$$
Restriction along opens composes by restriction to the same open, so this gives the canonical $j_{2!}j_{1!}\cong(j_2j_1)_!$. For three opens both comparisons transpose to the same identity of triple restriction; identity opens do likewise. Exactness [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact] lets these natural maps and equations descend degreewise to $D^+$. The comparison with their etale counterparts respects these compositions by [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison].

source.place: Tags 09AE and 09AF, adjoint characterization and open composition; elementary Hom-bijection calculation

proof.text:
For a commutative proper/open square $Q$ with top open $k:A\hookrightarrow B$, bottom open $i:C\hookrightarrow D$ and proper verticals $r:A\to C$, $p:B\to D$, let $\gamma^e_Q:i^e_!Rr^e_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp^e_*k^e_!$ be [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence]. It needs no Cartesian hypothesis. On a witnessed $N=A_A L$, define the pro-etale map by the fully specified conjugation
$$i^p_!Rr^p_*A_A L\xrightarrow{\sim}A_D(i^e_!Rr^e_*L)\xrightarrow{A_D\gamma^e_Q}A_D(Rp^e_*k^e_!L)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp^p_*k^p_!A_A L.$$
The outer arrows are the comparisons of step 2. Conjugate further by the input witness for general $N$. This is natural for all morphisms by step 2. Its horizontal and vertical pasting and identity equations are the equations of the cited etale lemma: substitute this expression for each gamma, cancel the adjacent inverse comparisons, and use the composition/identity compatibility of [prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image] and [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Each remaining expression is $A_D$ of the corresponding etale equation, conjugated by the same source and target comparisons. Thus no conservativity of arbitrary pro-etale geometric stalks is used.

source.place: Tags 0F7B, 0F7C, 0F7D: proper/open map, vertical and horizontal composition; pro-etale comparison by 09AF and 099R

proof.text: For the refinement square $r=\operatorname{id}_X$, $k=j_1$, $i=j_2$, $p=u$, [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence] identifies $\gamma^e_Q$ with the specific etale $\alpha^e_u$. The named-map equality [lem-sf-proper-open-comparison-site-normalization] then identifies the map of step 5 with the specified pro-etale $\alpha^p_u$, not just some isomorphism with the same ends. By [def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism](a),(b), its inverse followed by proper-composition is exactly the refinement comparison $\theta_u$ used in [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed]. Therefore the gamma maps for refinement squares, and their pasting equations from step 5, use the actual compactification-coherence comparisons of the statement.

source.place: Tags 0F7B and 0F7G, refinement normalization; Tag 0F7J, comparison squares A, D, E

proof.text:
Apply step 5 to the Cartesian square $pb=vp_Y$ of step 3, with input $c_!K$, which remains of bounded-below etale origin by step 2. On these models the natural isomorphism is
$$Rg_!^dRf_!^{(c,p_Y)}=Rq_*v_!Rp_{Y*}c_!\xrightarrow{Rq_*\gamma_Q}Rq_*Rp_*b_!c_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(qp)_*a_!=R(gf)_!^{(a,qp)}.$$
The last arrow uses step 4 and the finite-level direct-image composition of [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition](1). Conjugate this map by the natural compactification comparisons [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed] to obtain $\alpha_{g,f}$ for the chosen candidates in [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Every arrow is an isomorphism on the stated witnessed domain. The direct-image compositor is unital and associative by the last paragraph of [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition].

We verify that the model map commutes with refinement of a whole tower. Two towers admit a common refining tower by [lem-cbc-compactifiable-compatible-tower], so compare tower 1 refining tower 2. Write the proper refinement maps as $u:\overline Y_1\to\overline Y_2$, $v:\overline X_1\to\overline X_2$, $w:V_1\to V_2$; the cited node gives all commuting equations, including $p_2v=up_1$ and $p_{Y,2}w=p_{Y,1}$. Put $I_i=v_{i!}$ for the open $v_i:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y_i$, $J_i=c_{i!}$, $B_i=b_{i!}$, $P_i=Rp_{i*}$, $L_i=Rp_{Y,i*}$, $M=Ru_*$, $H=Rv_*$, $H'=Rw_*$. Suppress only canonical coherent compositors, so $P_2H=MP_1$, $L_2H'=L_1$. The refinement squares A, D, E yield $\gamma_A:J_2\to H'J_1$, $\gamma_D:I_2\to MI_1$, $\gamma_E:B_2J_2\to HB_1J_1$. The two model squares give $\gamma_B:I_2L_2\to P_2B_2$, $\gamma_C:I_1L_1\to P_1B_1$; the connecting square F gives $\gamma_F:B_2H'\to HB_1$. All have proper verticals and open horizontals, even though A,D,E,F need not be Cartesian. Step 5 gives
$$\gamma_E=(\gamma_FJ_1)(B_2\gamma_A),\qquad(M\gamma_C)(\gamma_DL_1)=(P_2\gamma_F)(\gamma_BH').$$
Naturality of $\gamma_B$ at $\gamma_{A,K}$ gives
$$(P_2B_2\gamma_A)(\gamma_BJ_2)=(\gamma_BH'J_1)(I_2L_2\gamma_A).$$
Substitution yields
$$(P_2\gamma_E)(\gamma_BJ_2)=(M\gamma_CJ_1)(\gamma_DL_1J_1)(I_2L_2\gamma_A).$$
Composition in these formulas is read right to left. Applying $Rq_{2*}$, the compositor of [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition] and step 6 identify this equation with the compatibility of the model composition maps with all three specified refinement comparisons. The choice-independent cocycle of [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed] cancels comparisons through the common tower. This proves independence of all tower and compactification choices; the common tower, rather than a mere common refinement in one Comp category, is essential.

source.place: Tag 0F7J, lemma-shriek-composition, squares A--F and final pasting calculation

proof.text: For $f=\operatorname{id}_X$ choose the tower with compactification of $f$ equal to $(\operatorname{id}_X,\operatorname{id}_X)$, and the same compactification for $g$ and $gf$. The model proper/open square then has identity verticals, so its gamma is the identity by step 5. For $g=\operatorname{id}_Y$ use its identity compactification and any compactification of $f$; now the model square has identity horizontals and its gamma is the identity. The extension comparisons of step 4 and the direct-image unit comparisons [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition] are the canonical unit identifications. Step 8 transfers these equalities to arbitrary chosen compactifications by [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed], yielding both unit laws.

For $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gS\xrightarrow hT$, choose successive compactifications $S\xhookrightarrow{z}\overline S\xrightarrow rT$, $Y\xhookrightarrow{v}\overline Y\xrightarrow q\overline S$ of $zg$, and $X\xhookrightarrow a\overline X\xrightarrow p\overline Y$ of $vf$, using [thm-nagata-compactification] and [lem-weil-pbc-compatible-compactification-triangle]. Set $W=\overline Y\times_{\overline S}S$, $V=\overline X\times_{\overline Y}W$, $U=\overline X\times_{\overline Y}Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write the open maps as $d:Y\hookrightarrow W$, $i:W\hookrightarrow\overline Y$, $c:U\hookrightarrow V$, $b:V\hookrightarrow\overline X$, $j:X\hookrightarrow U$, so $id=v$, $bcj=a$. The proper projections are $q_S:W\to S$, $p_W:V\to W$, $p_Y:U\to Y$; their properties follow by successive applications of the compatible-triangle statement to the compactified maps and their open restrictions. The adjacent squares A, B, C have gamma maps
$$\gamma_A:d_!Rp_{Y*}\to Rp_{W*}c_!,\quad\gamma_B:i_!Rp_{W*}\to Rp_*b_!,\quad\gamma_C:z_!Rq_{S*}\to Rq_*i_!.$$
By step 8 compute both parenthesizations on this one staircase. From $Rr_*z_!Rq_{S*}d_!Rp_{Y*}j_!$, the first uses A followed by the vertical rectangle B+C; the second uses C followed by the horizontal rectangle A+B. Step 5 gives
$$\gamma_{A+B}=(\gamma_Bc_!)(i_!\gamma_A),\qquad\gamma_{B+C}=(Rq_*\gamma_B)(\gamma_CRp_{W*}).$$
Naturality of $\gamma_C$ at $\gamma_{A,K}$ is precisely
$$(\gamma_CRp_{W*}c_!)(z_!Rq_{S*}\gamma_A)=(Rq_*i_!\gamma_A)(\gamma_Cd_!Rp_{Y*}).$$
Whisker by $Rr_*$ and $j_!$ and compose with $Rq_*\gamma_Bc_!$. The two paths are now equal to the same map into $Rr_*Rq_*Rp_*b_!c_!j_!$. Step 4 and the associative compositor [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition] identify this with $R(rqp)_*a_!$. The cocycle [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed] conjugates this equality to the original choices, proving the associativity clause.

split_report.summary: Expanded the two imported paragraphs into ten steps on the stated pro-etale etale-origin domain. Explicit finite-level coefficient binding and hypotheses on the third morphism make inherited conventions unambiguous. Reused existing compatible triangles/towers, etale proper/open interchange and its pasting equations, full-faithful comparison, and compactification coherence. Added one statement-only named-map site-comparison normalization lemma; no new clause of the item. Gave the A--F tower-refinement calculation, both unit cases, and the A,B,C associativity calculation. The unmatched audit cohomological-dimension declaration belongs to existing thm-sc-finite-type-torsion-cd.
split_report.blueprint: Steps 1--7 realize Construction (Nagata, compatible Cartesian model, proper/open exchange, composition). Steps 5--6 and 8--10 realize Independence and associativity, including both identity cases absent from the imported proof. The etale/proetale comparison justifies the same proper/open route without assuming pro-etale geometric stalk conservativity.
